claims.claim: Direct Belgium Gearbox ford Expedition V8 4WD
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a used manual transmission/gearbox assembly with hoses/wiring and linkages, but no readable make/model/part number or markings confirming Ford Expedition V8 4WD or Belgium origin.
Photos show a dusty dismantled gearbox assembly; there is no seal/inspection evidence or readable tamper indicators to confirm it was never opened.
No test video, sound recording, or functional run/bench test results are shown in the witness report.
No odometer/usage meter, gearbox code, or documentation is shown/readable in the photos.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (Ford Expedition V8 4WD compatibility not verifiable; gearbox code/part number not readable).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the gearbox identification plate/label and/or stamped gearbox code/part number (and any matching vehicle/engine code), plus a photo showing the exact transfer case/4WD interface if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used manual gearbox assembly with unknown compatibility (highest risk of mismatch).

risks.risk: Incomplete assembly / missing internal or external parts (some ports/connectors look disconnected; exact missing sensors/solenoids/shift linkage not shown).
risks.proof: A full inventory photo laid out: every sensor/solenoid, shift linkage/lever, connectors, bolts, and any transfer-case related parts—plus a shot showing all ports fully accounted for.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed complete; treated as needing parts sourcing/repairs.

risks.risk: Unknown internal condition (synchros/gears/bearings not testable from photos; no knock claim not evidenced).
risks.proof: A short video of a bench test or functional test showing gear engagement (multiple gears) and no abnormal noise, ideally with the gearbox mounted and running.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/untested for internal health (worst-case: may require overhaul).

risks.risk: Leak/seal/gasket condition unknown (oil level, seals, and gasket integrity not shown).
risks.proof: Photos of the gearbox after wiping clean, showing no fresh oil seepage, plus a close-up of gasket/seal areas and any wet spots; include a quick wipe-and-wait clip if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potential leak risk (worst-case: reseal/replace gaskets).

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than implied (dust/sand suggests dismantled storage; parts may be damaged during removal).
risks.proof: Close-ups of all visible mounting points, connector pins, hose ends, and any damaged/bent lines; include a straight-on shot of the casing for cracks/dents.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible handling damage.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the gearbox identification plate/label and any stamped gearbox code/part number (must be readable).
Send photos showing every external component/port fully accounted for (sensors/solenoids/shift linkage/transfer-case interface if applicable).
Provide a short video of a bench/functional test: gear engagement across multiple gears and confirmation of no abnormal noise.
Provide evidence of leak status: wipe-clean then show no fresh seepage, with close-ups of seals/gaskets and any wet areas.
response.reason: The witness can confirm it is a used manual transmission/gearbox assembly, but the seller’s key fitment and condition claims (Ford Expedition V8 4WD, tested/no knock, low mileage, never opened) are not verifiable from the photos. Without readable identification and test evidence, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
